Label: Wrist Light
Text: You can activate your wrist light by pressing [lightkey]. The wrist light can be upgraded by placing topaz gems in your MEG tool.

Label: MEG Information
Text:
The MEG tool is your laser powered wrist tool with a variety of features. It can project light into the environment, dig blocks out of the world, pull items to you, scan creatures, scan the environment for useful resources, display a local map and even grapple to nearby surfaces. The MEG tool's range is limited to the area around you, but the range can be upgraded by installing sapphires. The MEG tool also allows you to communicate with the U.N. Hephaestus's central artificial intelligence core.

Modules for the MEG tool's various functions can be found in the Key Items pouch.

Label: MEG Energy, Capacitor and Batteries
Text:
Your installed capacitor determines how much energy you have immediate access to. The capacitor recharges over time using harvested ambient energy, but a charged battery installed in your MEG tool refills the capacitor much faster.

To recharge a battery, place it in a powered charging station.

Label: AGIS
Text:
AGIS is your personal helpful AI. A thin client is mounted on your wrist, which interfaces with the Hephaestus computers in order to provide you with situation and tactical advice while exploring unfamiliar environments.

You can contact AGIS while on the Hephaestus by interacting with panels mounted on the wall, and once you have a MEG tool installed on your wrist, you can contact AGIS by pressing the call button to the left of your HUD's item slots.

AGIS can help you by telling you about things in the world, or giving you direction on what you should be doing.

Label: AGIS Guidance
Text:
Your AGIS wrist-mounted companion can help give you guidance if you aren't sure what to do.
[image:Sprites/Help/agis-button]
Click the AGIS call button to start a dialog with AGIS, and then ask him what you should be doing.
[image:Sprites/Help/agis-help-dialog]

Label: Cutting Down Trees
Text:
To cut down a tree, equip your dig laser, aim at the tree, and hold [primary] until it falls. Collect the dropped wood with [grablaserkey].

You can also cut down trees with an axe. Stand close to the trunk and press [primary] to swing. Keep chopping until the tree falls.

Tree trunks can only be broken with an axe, as the wrist laser cannot penetrate deep into the trunk and roots.

Label: Dig Tool
Text:
Your MEG tool comes equipped with a dig laser that is tuned to specific frequencies of light that allow it to dig through blocks. The digging power is limited by the quality of lens you have installed in your MEG tool, and the number of blocks that you can simultaneously dig can be increased by installing rubies.

You can dig with the wrist laser by equipping it and then pressing [primary] on blocks you can see in the world. You can press [worldsecondary] to dig blocks out of the background.

Your wrist laser dig tool is accessible from the first slot on your hotbar, but it can also be found in the Key Items pouch.

Label: Inventory Usage
Text:
Your inventory can be accessed by pressing [menukey] or by clicking the backpack icon on the top of your HUD. In order to pick up items, you can either drag them from the world into your pack with your mouse cursor or you can use the Grab Laser tool by pressing [grablaserkey] and pointing at the item. You can also drag items from your inventory back into the world.

Note: When you die and lose your items, they are stored in a dropped backpack. They do not decay, and you can return to the backpack to recover them.

Label: Key Items
Text: Key items are items that cannot be dropped and will stay with you when you die. Your key items will automatically be stored in the pouch on the left side of your backpack.

Label: Trashing Items
Text: You can trash items by either selecting them with [uiprimary] and selecting the trash can icon to the side of the item's description or by dragging them to the trash pouch on the right side of your backpack. Items marked as trash will be removed the next time you exit the game.

Label: Containers
Text: Containers can be opened by selecting them with [secondary], and items can be dragged in or out.

Label: Eating Food
Text:
In order to eat food, you must first equip it and then press [primary] in the world. You can equip the food by either selecting it with [secondary] in your inventory or selecting it from the food slot on your hotbar.

As long as you have some food in your stomach you will regenerate health slowly.

Label: Hotbar
Text:
By default, your hotbar will automatically fill with items from your inventory and you can scroll through the item in a category's slot with ([itemcycle]).

[image:Sprites/Help/hotbar-automatic]

You can hold the hotbar slot number to open a radial menu, with all the items in the category.

[image:Sprites/Help/hotbar-radial]

If you'd prefer a simpler, more familiar hotbar, you can use the MANUAL mode:

[image:Sprites/Help/hotbar-mode-switch]

In manual mode, you can drag items directly to the hotbar.

[image:Sprites/Help/hotbar-manual]

Label: Equipping Clothing and Armor
Text: You can equip clothing and armor by either selecting them with [secondary] in your inventory or by dragging them to the appropriate slot in your equipment menu. Your equipment menu can be accessed by clicking the button at the top of your HUD.

Label: Building Projects
Text: Some objects that you can craft are too big to fit in your inventory, and they must be built in the world. All of the projects that you have recipes for can be found by clicking the bottom left button in the Crafting Menu. As long as you have the items required to craft the project, you'll be able to choose a place in the world to build after pressing the "Build in World" button. You can cancel building a project in the world by pressing [worldsecondary] before you select a location to build.

Label: Grab Laser
Text: Your MEG tool comes equipped with a grab laser that can be used to retrieve items in the world. You can retract items at your mouse cursor by holding [grablaserkey]. The range of the grab laser is restricted by the quality of the Sapphire in your MEG tool.

Label: Auto Organize Containers
Text: You can also build special containers that automatically collect materials when they are added to your main backpack. There is a Hunter's Pouch, Forager's Pouch and Excavator's Pouch.

Label: Changing Ammo
Text: Some weapons or gadgets may have multiple ammo types. To change the ammo type on a weapon, you can either select it in your inventory and change it in the item details, or you can hold [reload] while the item is equipped to select the ammo from a radial menu.

Label: Minimap
Text: Your MEG tool has a built-in mapping feature, which constantly scans the area around you and adds it to your Minimap, which can be accessed by pressing [minimapkey]. Your Minimap is also able to detect navigational beacons.

Label: Placing Blocks
Text: To place blocks, you must equip a block from your inventory, and then press [primary] in the world to place it. You can press [worldsecondary] in order to place blocks in the background.

Label: Wrist Scanner
Text:
Your MEG tool is equipped with a standard issue wrist scanner, which sends out pulses of mostly harmless radiation that can scan creatures and send the data to your Codex. To review the scans, open the Codex ([codexhotkey]).

You can also hold [orescankey] to send out scanning pulses that can reflect off of materials underground depending on the density. On a controller, equip the Wrist Scanner first.

Label: Holster
Text: You can holster your weapon by pressing [holsterkey]. You can also unequip a held item by clicking it on your hotbar or by using [hotbarselect].

Label: Red Comet
Text: A red comet seems to appear from time to time. It doesn't seem to have any kind of predictable pattern, but it seems to be quite spooky.

Label: Ladders
Text: Ladders can be used by approaching them and pressing up ([up]), or down ([down]). You can also jump ([jump]) off the ladder at any time, and you can drop off the ladder by pressing crouch ([crouch]).

Label: Seismic Imager
Text:
The seismic imager uses acoustic waves to map the nearby terrain. To activate the device, insert your MEG tool (and accompanying arm) into the port on the side. Make sure to leave space to stand for the rest of the attached body as well when selecting a place to build one.

Once built, simply use [worldsecondary] on it to automatically approach it and start a scan. Once the scan is finished, the map data will be uploaded to your wrist map and minimap.

Label: Osiris Housing and Crew
Text:
With the Hephaestus in the sky above Osiris, it is now possible to thaw some of the frozen crew and bring them down to help out around the planet.

The crew computer in the Pioneer Station is where you are able to manage the crew, including thawing and re-freezing them if necessary. You can use that computer to assign thawed crew to various tasks, like farming or cooking.

Each crew member requires a valid room, which must be at least 8 tiles wide and 4 tiles tall. There also must be a source of light and a bed.

The Pneumail storage near the computer is used by the thawed crew to store things they produce, and they will also draw from the same storage if they need raw materials such as cooking ingredients.

Label: Hacking
Text: You managed to download an encryption key from Dr. Hahn's office which allows you to hack into various devices using your wrist scanner.

Label: Grapple Module
Text: You've installed a grapple module into your MEG tool which can pull you to nearby terrain. To use it, hold the [grapplekey] to project a guide laser, and release the key to fire the grapple module.
